verbs.bind: establish and freeze an identity relationship
verbs.decode: extract semantic output and retained wire evidence
verbs.encode: map semantic input into a wire request
verbs.lower: convert a public declaration into host runtime form
verbs.normalize: map vendor data into the controlled runtime vocabulary
verbs.prepare: materialize a validated runtime preparation through the kernel adapter
verbs.project: produce a read-only representation for another authority
verbs.resolve: select or answer a runtime object at a boundary
verbs.render: project semantic state into model-facing input
verbs.settle: apply accounting policy to an observed measurement
